summary: BI-28C22BE3 (EP-5F6369AB). A Prisma relation is mirrored once per foreign key, from the model that holds it, under a typed relation. Migration 20261105100000_retire_relates_to retires the RELATES_TO relation type and drops its derived graph_edge rows; the code-graph reconcile (projection version 4) rewrites them as HAS_FOREIGN_KEY_TO. The EA data-model mirror retypes its associated_with rows to has_foreign_key_to (or composed_of for a required cascading key) and deletes the back-relation duplicates on its next run.
affectedCopies: graph_edge rows of type RELATES_TO (code graph, derived from packages/db/prisma/schema/*.prisma): deleted by the migration, rewritten as HAS_FOREIGN_KEY_TO by apps/web/lib/build/code-graph/graph-projection.ts
EaRelationship rows written by the data-model mirror (properties.sourceKey prisma:relation:*): retyped or, for back-relation duplicates, deleted by apps/web/lib/ea/data-model-mirror-apply.ts
graph_edge rows of type ASSOCIATED_WITH projected from those EA rows: removed by pruneStaleEaRelationshipEdges (packages/db/src/graph-sync.ts) after the mirror re-projects

migration.backfill: The deleted RELATES_TO edges are derived; the code-graph reconcile (every 15 minutes, projection version bumped to 4) rewrites them typed. On the dev install on 2026-10-28 the migration ran in a rolled-back transaction and left 0 RELATES_TO rows. The EA retype runs in the data-model mirror's next scheduled reconcile; no row holds information the FK-side row does not.
migration.rollback: Forward-only. Rolling the code back would let the code graph write RELATES_TO again, which the retired status refuses, so roll back the migration's UPDATE with it.
